answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a Verkle-tree polynomial commitment over its staked state, so a single sybil registration produces a detectable ripple in the commitment frontier that peers verify via constant-size proofs. Stateless clients then mirror the sparrow-like lightweight witnesses of honest agents, pruning archival bandwidth while cross-checking. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
